diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.panel.title: Troubleshoot and share
diagnostics.panel.description: Run one health check, review what actually needs attention, and only then use fixes or support exports.
diagnostics.fixes.title: Suggested fixes
diagnostics.fixes.description: Only actions that match the current health check are shown here.
diagnostics.fixes.empty-description: Run health check first so FolderView Plus can suggest the right repair path.
diagnostics.summary.empty-title: Run health check to inspect the plugin state.
diagnostics.summary.empty-description: The summary will call out Docker, VM, storage, icon, and update issues without dumping raw JSON first.
diagnostics.support.title: Share with support
diagnostics.support.description: Use the issue report for quick triage and the support bundle when someone needs the full picture.
diagnostics.support.note: Support bundle exports are sanitized by default and include the troubleshooting data needed for support.
diagnostics.support.preview-description: Included sections and redaction categories will appear here before you download the bundle.
diagnostics.localization.label: Localization
diagnostics.localization.healthy: The active language catalog is current.
diagnostics.localization.load-error: One or more language catalogs could not be loaded.
diagnostics.localization.review-needed: $1 is partially translated and needs human review.
diagnostics.localization.source-detail: $1 source messages across $2 namespaces are loaded.
diagnostics.localization.stale: $1 translated messages may predate the current English source.
diagnostics.localization.runtime-missing: $1 missing keys were observed in this page session.
diagnostics.localization.extraction-debt: $1 legacy UI string candidates still need explicit catalog bindings.
diagnostics.performance.note: Recent UI operation timings from the last 15 minutes. Cold loads are observed but do not trigger a warning by themselves.
diagnostics.activity.empty-description: Folder changes, backups, imports, and recovery actions will appear here.
diagnostics.history.refresh-description: Refresh history after a save, import, restore, or undo to review the latest recovery-safe events.
diagnostics.history.empty-description: Recent change cards will appear here for the selected recovery source.
diagnostics.fixes.none-title: No repair actions are recommended right now.
diagnostics.fixes.none-description: The current health check does not suggest any one-click fixes.
diagnostics.theme.live-title: Theme diagnostics are live before a full health check.
diagnostics.theme.live-description: Run health check to refresh Docker, VM, storage, icon, and update cards. The theme card below updates immediately on page load.
